AANP-style FNP preparation

This simulator uses source-derived single-best-answer practice from the uploaded PDF. It is an independent study tool and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or presented as official AANP exam content. All numbered source records are preserved. Interactive Q/A entries retain the PDF-paired answer. Distractors are taken only from other PDF answers, matched by response type and clinical section; answer positions are balanced.

ItemSystemSourceExplanationClinical review
Source-master rule: all numbered PDF source records are preserved in the embedded master archive. Every interactive item keeps its paired PDF answer. No source record is deleted for duplication or formatting. Distractors are auxiliary simulator choices taken only from other PDF answers. FINAL V10 matches them by response family and topic similarity; they are never treated as source answers. External clinical validation, if added later, must remain separate from the source answer.
